verdict.rationale: The writing-skills SKILL.md (superpowers-docs-15) gives a concrete meta-skill/spec (write test cases, watch fail, write skill docs, watch pass, refactor) for authoring new skills, and docs-62 confirms 'writing-skills module teaches you to author and test new skills.' The harness-agnostic skills structure and porting guide (docs-13, docs-37, docs-59, docs-66) further show a documented, followable process for packaging skills across harnesses. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an agent actually authoring a new skill end-to-end via this meta-skill (only first-party docs cited), and more detail on the 'packaging' step (marketplace publishing) for a self-authored skill.
